ideas.title: Minnesota ICE incidents: A deeper look into corruption and public safety
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent incidents involving ICE officers and anti-ICE protesters in Minnesota, and explore potential corruption and public safety concerns.
questions: What are the causes of the recent incidents?
